name: @gamely/core-native-html5
author: RodrigoDornelles
description: create your own game-engine with just javascript or lua.

scripts.build:browser: cd ../.. && node cli.js bundler js npm/core-native-html5/src/index.js --outfile npm/core-native-html5/dist/index.js --global CoreNativeHtml5
scripts.build:fengari: cd ../.. && node cli.js bundler js npm/core-native-html5/src/fengari.js --outfile npm/core-native-html5/dist/fengari.js --global CoreNativeHtml5
scripts.build:wasmoon: cd ../.. && node cli.js bundler js npm/core-native-html5/src/wasmoon.js --outfile npm/core-native-html5/dist/wasmoon.js --global CoreNativeHtml5
scripts.build:cjs: cd ../.. && node cli.js bundler js npm/core-native-html5/src/index.js --outfile npm/core-native-html5/dist/index.cjs.js --format cjs
scripts.build:mjs: cd ../.. && node cli.js bundler js npm/core-native-html5/src/index.js --outfile npm/core-native-html5/dist/index.mjs --format esm
scripts.build: npm run build:browser && npm run build:fengari && npm run build:wasmoon && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:mjs
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run check
